title: SE + ProServices Weekly Sync — Customer Health Digest (2026-03-12)
content:
Meeting: SE + ProServices weekly customer integration sync
Date: 2026-03-12
Time: 10:00–10:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #se-proservices Slack sync
Attendees: Aisha Patel (SE Lead), Connor Lee (Field Eng), Diego Marquez (ProServices PM), Hannah Cho (SRE), Priya Nair (Customer Success - partial)
Observed: quick run of current integration slate and high-risk items; aim to close two customer blockers and confirm rollout windows for two mid-stage pilots.

AGENDA
1) Quick status roll-call (top 6 integrations)
2) Deep-dive: Veridian blocker (cert/data-plane mismatch)
3) Capacity / Dedicated pool reservation asks (Q2)
4) Open action review and owners
5) Escalations & decisions needed this week

SUMMARY ACTION SUMMARY (TL;DR)
- Veridian: High risk — data-plane TLS cert mismatch. SRE to produce mitigation runbook and temporary fallback by 2026-03-15.
- Nebula: On track — canary scheduled 2026-03-18; must finalize prompt-set tests by 2026-03-15.
- AtlasCorp: Blocked by schema contract review; legal and customer data team sync scheduled 2026-03-14.
- Lighthouse (pilot): Deployment in progress; telemetry spike observed at 95th token latency — probing batching config with infra.
- Q2 capacity requests: field teams aggregated needs; finalize Dedicated pool sizing by 2026-03-19.

DETAILED CUSTOMER NOTES
1) Veridian (priority: P1 / high risk)
- Current status: Integration halted. Customer reports TLS handshake failures between their on-prem gateway and our private connector (data plane). Certificate presented by connector does not include SAN expected by customer's proxy.
- Root cause suspected: recent cert rotation on private connector changed SAN ordering; automated verification step missed due to edge-case in our cert-generation script (infra PR 217).
- Impact: Streaming generation calls fail intermittently for 25% of requests; customer placed dev traffic on hold.
- Immediate mitigation: Hannah to produce a rollback/temporary cert overlay and runbook for customer to accept the cert (not ideal) by 2026-03-13 EOD. Connor will coordinate a temporary routing rule to send Veridian calls to hosted fallback for non-sensitive workloads by 2026-03-14.
- Next steps: Diego to own postmortem with Veridian and legal (if needed) by 2026-03-18. Link: PROJ-4821.

2) Nebula (priority: P2 / on track)
- Status: Canary slated for 2026-03-18. Engineering checklist 80% complete.
- Outstanding: Prompt set for hallucination/consistency tests needs final review (Aisha + Product). Connor to finish prompt ablation and upload artifacts by 2026-03-15.
- Risk: If prompt tests fail, fallback to previous model variant will be required; plan in place to roll back within 30 minutes but will require extra QA.

3) AtlasCorp (priority: P2 / blocked)
- Status: Blocked on schema and PII scoping; Atlas legal requested packet-level dataflow diagram and retention table.
- Action: Diego and Priya to run a joint session with Atlas technical lead and legal on 2026-03-14 09:00 PT. Deliverable: signed minimal-data contract or explicit retention SLA.
- Impact: Onboarding timeline delayed by ~2 weeks if not resolved.

4) Lighthouse (priority: P3 / pilot)
- Status: Rolling deployment. Observed telemetry: 95th percentile token latency increased from 220ms to 340ms after enabling continuous batching on the dedicated pool.
- Investigation: Hannah and infra will test batching window and KV cache settings; hypothesis is batch size tradeoff bumping serialization cost for this workload profile.
- Temporary: Adjust batching policy (max wait 8ms) and report metrics by 2026-03-14.

CAPACITY / Q2 PLANNING
- Field teams aggregated Dedicated pool requests for next quarter; initial ask totals 24 GPUs reserved (mixed A100/RTX), with burst allowance of 8 GPUs.
- Decision needed: finalize reservation by 2026-03-19 to hit vendor procurement timelines. Diego to circulate final spec and cost estimate today.

OPEN ACTIONS (updated)
- Hannah: Cert rollback runbook + verification steps for Veridian (due 2026-03-13).
- Connor: Configure hosted fallback route for Veridian non-sensitive traffic and validate (due 2026-03-14).
- Diego: Schedule Atlas legal sync and draft minimal-data contract template (due 2026-03-14).
- Aisha: Finish Nebula prompt ablation and upload test set to S3 (due 2026-03-15).
- Infra (assigned: Miguel): Investigate Lighthouse batching perf and propose safe max-wait (due 2026-03-14).
- Diego: Consolidate Q2 Dedicated pool request and send finance estimate (due 2026-03-12 COB). (Note: finance asked for cost per token estimate — use recent telemetry.)

DECISIONS MADE
- Temporary hosted fallback will be used for Veridian until cert is fully resolved; permanent fix to be scheduled as part of connector hotfix release.
- We will not expand batch window beyond 10ms for Lighthouse until we confirm KV cache behavior in staging.

RISKS & MITIGATION
- Risk: Cert rotation edge-cases can repeat across other private connectors. Mitigation: add SAN schema validation to cert generation pipeline and a pre-rotation verification job (SRE / infra task).
- Risk: Delayed Q2 reservation decision could push customers to self-host, increasing churn risk. Mitigation: propose a short-term burst credit for high-priority pilots if procurement lag occurs.

NOTES / REFERENCES
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/217 (cert generation changes)
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.local/display/SE/Integration+Postmortem+Template
- Jira: PROJ-4821 (Veridian incident tracking)

NEXT MEETING
- Weekly sync: 2026-03-19 10:00 PT
- Focus: Veridian remediation confirmation, Q2 capacity finalize, Nebula canary readiness

APPENDIX: QUICK USER NOTES (for handoff to CS)
- For CS to share with customers: short script to switch to hosted fallback and validate requests; Connor to draft and post to shared CS folder by 2026-03-13.
- Customer-facing note: apologize for intermittent streaming disruption; we will follow up with a detailed timeline after the fix and invite Atlas/Veridian to a technical review session.

END OF NOTES
